## Instagram
Direct messages to the Instagram professional account linked to the Facebook Page (Messenger API for Instagram, Page token). When the workflow is published, the trigger subscribes the Meta app to Instagram events (`messages`, `messaging_postbacks`) and checks each event's signature with the app secret. Each message is turned into the common format and stored by **Ingest message**; the reply comes from **Reply turn**.
